metadata.title: Comprehensive Audit and Reconciliation of Controlled Privacy-Utility Study
metadata.eval_partition: Locked Held-Out Test Set (20%, N=1,253, seed 42)

audit_1_seed42_reconciliation.finding: The difference between 69.43% (Phase 2 Config D) and 68.56% (Phase 3 Seed 42) was caused strictly by noise_seed_base. In Phase 2 line 435, noise_seed_base was hardcoded to 9999, yielding 69.43%. In Phase 3 line 537, noise_seed_base was parameterized as s*100=4200, yielding 68.56%. All other parameters (architecture, weights initialization, client partitions, batch shuffling per epoch, and locked test set) were 100% identical.

audit_2_paillier_numerical_equivalence.finding: Round-by-round vector comparison confirms exact numerical equivalence. Fixed-point scaling with S=1e6 limits max absolute error to <= 4.93e-7 and relative L2 error to <= 3.54e-6 across all rounds. When models are updated in lockstep, final classification accuracy difference is 0.0000%.
audit_2_paillier_numerical_equivalence.config_a_vs_b_explanation: Config A (75.26%) and Config B (73.82%) showed a 1.44% divergence because they were executed as separate independent training runs rather than side-by-side lockstep runs. In independent runs, the tiny 4.81e-7 initial rounding error is amplified across 96 non-convex Adam SGD epochs (8 rounds * 12 epochs), driving the optimization into adjacent local minima. Under direct lockstep comparison, encryption induces 0.0000% accuracy loss.

audit_3_dp_accounting_verification.client_adjacency_definition: Two distributed cohorts D, D' differ by replacing or removing one entire hospital client node out of K=3 clients.
audit_3_dp_accounting_verification.sensitivity: Delta_2 = C = 8.0 (bounded by L2 gradient clipping on each client's delta vector)
audit_3_dp_accounting_verification.noise_distribution: Gaussian N(0, (sigma * C)^2 * I_d), where d = 11,206 parameters
audit_3_dp_accounting_verification.participation_ratio: q = 1.0 (Full participation of all 3 clients every round; NO subsampling amplification claimed)
audit_3_dp_accounting_verification.composition_method: Linear RDP composition over T=8 rounds: R_alpha^(T) = T * alpha / (2 * sigma^2)
audit_3_dp_accounting_verification.minimal_epsilon_formula: eps* = T / (2 * sigma^2) + sqrt(2 * T * ln(1/delta)) / sigma
audit_3_dp_accounting_verification.post_processing_guarantee: The released global model w_(t+1) = w_t + (1/K) sum_i (Delta_i + eta_i) is a post-processing of the noisy client updates. Confidentiality against an honest-but-curious aggregation server is protected by Paillier secure aggregation.

critical_disclosures.record_level_dp: Technically unverified and unbounded. Client local training executes 12 epochs of Adam SGD without per-sample gradient clipping.
critical_disclosures.practical_privacy_interpretation: At sigma=0.01 (eps ≈ 41,357) and sigma=0.02 (eps ≈ 10,679), differential privacy provides empirical gradient perturbation against model inversion, NOT strong information-theoretic record-level privacy.

audit_5_baseline_decomposition.verdict: Over 54.8% of the gap to the paper's ~87.5% tree ensemble is the tabular representation gap between tree ensembles and neural networks. Differential privacy accounts for 33.6% of the gap. Paillier secure aggregation incurs 0.00% penalty.
